schema.comment: M26 schema ships with madden-franchise. Leave null to auto-pick by file header. Set schemaDirectory/schemaOverride only if auto-pick fails.

tables.comment: Table names + fields CONFIRMED against CAREER-TEST-SOURCE via inspect/snapshot (Madden 26, 1896 tables). Only SeasonGame has an in-row natural key. The stat tables carry NO in-row player/team identity (the row<->player mapping lives in separate pointer tables and is stable within a season), so positional (#index) identity is CORRECT for them — empty keyFields here is intentional, not a TODO. The 'using positional identity' warning on those tables is expected.

merge.comment: v1 PROVEN-IN-GAME transplant (results + season leaders). Playing a game makes Madden pre-sim the rest of the week for the ticker (provisional: IsSimmed=true, HasBeenPublished=false) — ignored via humanGameFilter, which selects ONLY the guest's actually-played official games. Copy the RESULT (allowlisted SeasonGame fields) + the SEASON player stats (clean — provisional sims don't commit season stats). NOT YET WORKING (see STANDINGS_NOTES.md / PHASE4_MERGE_DESIGN.md), so SKIPPED: standings/TeamStats (engine record-keeping can't be faked via file edits — 6 transplant pieces tried, no effect), career (polymorphic player->career mapping), box score (*StatCache reference tree). When standings is cracked, add tables here — the GUI needs no change.
merge.careerStatsComment: CAREER totals: each player has ONE cumulative career row via Player.CareerStats (direct ref to a position-specific Career*Stats table; no holder). The baseline-vs-guest diff for career is POLLUTED by provisional CPU sims (~172 rows change, but only the ~68 human-game players are real), so career is transplanted by a SEPARATE identity-scoped pass — NOT the positional diff path — copying each human-game player's career row guest->host. Career rows pre-exist for every player (even debuts), so no allocation needed.
merge.boxScoreComment: BOX SCORE (per-game player line / player-card game log): built from Player.GameStats -> GameStats[] holder -> per-game Game*Stats rows (each carries SeasonGame + OpposingTeam refs, NO player back-ref; SeasonGame.*PlayerStatCache is empty for ALL games and unused). For each human-game player we find their merged-game Game row via THEIR guest holder, allocate the row in host (copy scalars + the two refs verbatim since SeasonGame/Team align), and link it into a free GameStats holder slot. gameTables lists the per-game stat tables to transplant.
merge.teamBoxScoreComment: TEAM box score (the game's box-score PAGE team-totals tab). SOLVED + CONFIRMED IN-GAME 2026-06-26. The page renders team totals from THREE things, all required: (1) allocate the 2 per-game TeamStats rows guest->host (at the free-list head nextRecordToUse — same-index copy CORRUPTS the free list) and point SeasonGame.{Home,Away}TeamStatCache at them; (2) link each allocated row into that team's Team.TeamGameStatsRegSeason array at the WEEK-INDEXED slot the guest used (the page reads totals from THIS array, not the cache alone — caches set + array missing => 0s); (3) set SeasonGame.{Home,Away}TeamStatus=Reported (in resultFields). The earlier 'needs player snapshots / all-or-nothing' theory was WRONG: a known-good played game has HomePlayerStatCache/AwayPlayerStatCache=NULL and (often) ScoringSummaries=NULL yet renders team totals fine. Logos come from SeasonGame.Home/AwayTeam (already correct), NOT the scalar TeamStats row. STILL NOT built: the scoring-PLAYS list (ScoringSummaries tree) — cosmetic, optional.
merge.teamRecordComment: STANDINGS live on the Team record (id 5917) as split W/L fields (NOT in TeamStats). For each merged game's two teams, copy these scalar fields from guest->host. Clean: a game's two teams are unaffected by the provisional ticker sims, so their Team-record deltas are purely the real game.
